are_you_ok.title: Spectrum fiber optic lines intentionally cut in "criminal attack" in northeast Charlotte, officials say
are_you_ok.summary: Spectrum officials say fiber optic lines in northeast Charlotte were intentionally cut "in a criminal attack on our critical infrastructure." The incident happened early Monday morning, and the attack disrupted service for residents and businesses around Washington Boulevard, an area in northeast Charlotte, NC. Thefts of fiber optic lines are becoming increasingly common.

you_should_know.title: Thousands plan to rally against proposed hemp THC limits
you_should_know.summary: Hemp-derived THC manufacturers are planning a rally in Raleigh, the state capital about 165 miles northeast of Charlotte, NC, to protest House Bill 328, which seeks to impose state-level restrictions on THC content and age requirements before federal limits take effect in late 2026.
